<page>
 Cooper & Quinn LLP
 Pasadena, TX
 Phone 832-555-2058
 Settlement Demand
12/11/2023
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1484 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our firm represents Nathaniel Fleming in connection with the motor vehicle collision
that occurred on 07/12/2023 at a signalized intersection. Our client was proceeding
through the intersection on a green light when your insured failed to yield and struck
the driver's side of our client's vehicle. The force of the impact spun the vehicle and
caused it to strike the adjacent curb before coming to rest.
Our client was transported from the scene by ambulance and subsequently diagnosed with
a cervical neck strain, along with muscle spasms and restricted range of motion.
Treatment has included physical therapy, prescribed muscle relaxants, and ongoing
chiropractic care. Our client has missed several days of work and continues to
experience headaches and limited ability to perform routine household tasks.
The police report documents your insured's citation for failing to yield the right of
way, and the independent witness statement supports our client's account of the
signal. Liability is clear.
Based on the medical expenses incurred to date, lost wages, the ongoing nature of the
treatment, and the pain and suffering our cilent has endured, we demand payment of
$201,000.00 to resolve this claim. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the
date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period,
we will file suit without further notice.
Expert review: Melanie Munoz, orthopedic surgeon
Sincerely,
Matthew Day
Cooper & Quinn LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
